title: task-intent-v1: another app proposes Todoist tasks to Todofy
description: Inputs and outputs of the Todofy Intents methods proposeTasks and taskIntentStatus (README.md). Todofy is the only Todoist writer; a proposing app sends an intent with its own idempotency key and reads the outcome back. Every object is closed. Only the keywords that contracts/ops-v1/validate.mjs implements may be used here. Patterns end with $(?!\n): Python's re.search also matches $ before a final newline, ECMAScript does not.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC with Z, optional milliseconds.

Source.description: The proposing app. Todofy accepts only the sources it lists (TASK_INTENT_SOURCES) and applies that source's URL host allow-list.

IntentId.description: The proposer's idempotency key, unique per source for ever (Todofy keeps the ledger row). watch: digest-<YYYY-MM-DD> and urgent-<change id>.

Mode.description: subtasks: one parent task with one subtask per item. separate: one top-level task per item, no parent task.

BlockText.description: Plain text; newline (U+000A) is the only control character allowed.

HttpsUrl.description: An https URL with a lowercase host and a plain path; no query, fragment, credentials or port. Todofy also requires the host to be on the source's allow-list (watch: watch.ziyixi.science) and never fetches it.

TaskIntent.description: Input of proposeTasks. Todofy freezes it on first record: the same (source, intent_id) with any other content is rejected with intent_conflict.

State.description: README.md, States. created, duplicate and pending mean Todofy holds the intent; paused may or may not (see recorded); rejected and not_found created nothing.

ErrorCode.description: Why the state is not plain progress. Closed list: adding one changes this contract on both sides in one change.

TaskIntentResult.description: Output of both methods. Numbers, codes and the caller's own identifiers only: never task text, Todoist IDs or remote response text.

recorded.description: Todofy holds a ledger row for this (source, intent_id): its content is frozen there and the tasks will be (or were) created without another call.

tasks_total.description: Todoist tasks this intent creates: items, plus the parent in subtasks mode. 0 when nothing is recorded.

retry_after_seconds.description: When to ask again (taskIntentStatus while pending or held, proposeTasks after paused with recorded false); null when there is nothing to wait for.
